title: The Frequency home's Up next list prints the venue line and exact distance for events with a hidden address

source.ref: Site scan 2026-10-14 (scan nine, thread 'Site scan'), against origin/main eb26a01 and production.

detail: FILED 2026-10-14. THE CONSEQUENCE: lib/feed/frequency-home.ts:41 selects location and geog with the service role and ignores hide_address; components/frequency/members/feed/planner.tsx:326 prints e.location and works out miles from the exact point. The DAWN events index (app/(main)/events/index-data.ts:865) repeats the pattern. THE FIX: route the line through publicVisibleLocation and skip distance when hide_address is set and the viewer is not going. ── FIXED 2026-10-14 for the Frequency home: lib/feed/frequency-home.ts selects hide_address and the parts, shows publicVisibleLocation and no distance until the member is going or hosting; visible-location.test.ts pins the consumer. The DAWN events index (app/(main)/events/index-data.ts) is unchanged: DAWN is not the live design.
